lines: NRJN Family Trust, represented by Entrust Family Office Legal & Trusteeship Services, is an investor selling shareholder in the offer for sale.
Up to ₹141.96 crore in proceeds, if all offered shares are sold, from up to 1,050,000 shares at ₹1,352 each.
The timing is in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 248 days ago, so the trigger is not fresh.
Pre-offer holding and average cost of acquisition are unknown, so retained value and gain cannot be assessed.
